extracted_factors.Label: Simplified HCS/HCV Approach Implementation
extracted_factors.Description: The implementation of a simplified approach to improve deforestation risk management for smallholders, directly affecting forest management plans.

extracted_factors.Label: Expansion of Oil Palm Plantations
extracted_factors.Description: The significant increase of oil palm plantation areas in Indonesia influencing land use patterns and impacting traditional forest areas.

extracted_factors.Label: Deforestation Risk Concerns
extracted_factors.Description: Concerns driving the adoption of the HCS/HCV Approach to ensure sustainable management of forests against oil palm expansion.

extracted_factors.Label: Tembawang Forest Preservation
extracted_factors.Description: Results in maintaining areas of cultural and agricultural value important to local communities, preserving these resources against conversion.

extracted_factors.Label: Incentives and Benefits for Conservation
extracted_factors.Description: Provision of incentives or rewards for communities actively participating in forest conservation, directly influencing their conservation decisions.

extracted_factors.Label: Legal Recognition of Customary Land Rights
extracted_factors.Description: Outcome ensuring forest areas significant to indigenous peoples are legally protected, thereby stabilizing land tenure and promoting sustainable management.
